intent: Write the test for CorrelationWebFilter (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/intake/api/CorrelationWebFilter.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Single correlation middleware. Adopts the inbound X-Request-Id header or generates a UUID, echoes it in the X-Request-Id response header, and installs correlation by contextWrite of key requestId into the Reactor Context of the downstream chain (public constants CONTEXT_KEY="requestId", HEADER="X-Request-Id"). Correlation lives in the Reactor Context and as an explicit field of every audit record; no other propagation mechanism is installed. TEST DUTIES: Use MockServerWebExchange with a chain that reads the Reactor Context: header adopted when present, UUID generated when absent, response header echoed, context key requestId readable downstream.
